def kth_smallest(root, k):
    stack, node = [], root
    while True:
        while node:                    # push the left spine
            stack.append(node)
            node = node.left
        node = stack.pop()
        k -= 1
        if k == 0:
            return node.val
        node = node.right

def kth_smallest(root, k):
    vals = []

    def inorder(node):                 # the whole tree, sorted
        if node:
            inorder(node.left)
            vals.append(node.val)
            inorder(node.right)

    inorder(root)
    return vals[k - 1]
P22-minimum-absolute-difference-in-bst:
def get_minimum_difference(root):
    best, prev = float('inf'), None

    def inorder(node):                 # BST in-order = sorted
        nonlocal best, prev
        if not node:
            return
        inorder(node.left)
        if prev is not None:
            best = min(best, node.val - prev)
        prev = node.val
        inorder(node.right)

    inorder(root)
    return best
